blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Department of Health in Central Visayas (DOH-7) will begin its school-based vaccination drive against measles, rubella, and human papillomavirus (HPV) on November 3. The campaign, which will run until the end of December, targets 337,000 learners in Grades 1, 4, 5, and 7 during the 2026–2027 school year. Darryl A. […]...
